items.title: Ruth Brisbane interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 2, 2013
items.q: You’ll see me at the beginning of Cotton Club with the Hines Brothers, for a flash.

ctx.x: Were you a member of the union?

SAG? No not SAG, Actor’s Equity. Yes. I was a member of the Actor’s Equity, and also if you do commercials you have to join SAG. So I did a few SAG commercials, which is Screen Actors’ Guild. And a few little bits in movies. You’ll see me at the beginning of Cotton Club with the Hines Brothers, for a flash.
You’re lucky you didn’t end up on the cutting room floor I guess.
